en: Dependent on a state without applied thought and sustained thought, a state without applied thought and sustained thought arises by way of root condition … pe … Dependent on a state without applied thought but with sustained thought,
a state without applied thought but with sustained thought arises by way of root condition … pe … Dependent on a state without applied thought and without sustained thought,
a state without applied thought and without sustained thought arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)

With respect to the root condition (hetu), there are forty-eight; with respect to the object condition (ārammaṇa), forty-five; with respect to the predominance condition (adhipati), forty-seven …pe… with respect to the prenascence and repetition conditions (purejāta and āsevana), forty-four …pe… with respect to the non-disappearance condition (avigata), there are forty-eight.
